description: Adams, Sinayskiy, Agarwal and Petruccione found that across a viable range of J-coupling constants stronger coupling raises phosphorus coherence and concurrence, and that both lithium isotopes reduce them to almost nothing.
limitations: The J-couplings depend on a disputed Posner symmetry, so the parameters are not settled.

sources.quote: across a viable range of J-coupling constants, increased coupling strength increased phosphorus nuclear coherence and concurrence in Posner molecules
